Container.Name: isitdown-ui

Branch.TagDescription: The dashboard edition: polling, notifications and a local web dashboard.

Container.Overview:
IsItDown polls the public status pages of the providers you depend on — GitHub, Cloudflare, AWS, Anthropic and the rest — and tells you when one of them changes state.
This is the UI edition: everything the Light edition does, plus a local dashboard with a status grid, uptime charts and an incident timeline, and its whole configuration in SQLite rather than a file. Add providers and notification channels from the dashboard; nothing here needs a config file.
Secrets — bot tokens, webhook URLs — are read from the environment. Add one variable per credential below; the dashboard names the variable each channel is waiting for.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: The dashboard. It has no login: publish it only on a network you trust.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The SQLite database: providers, channels, history and incidents.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: The container's timezone. The dashboard can also be told to show times in a zone of its own.

Config.Name: Telegram bot token
Config.Description: Required if the Telegram channel is enabled.

Config.Name: Discord webhook URL
Config.Description: Required if the Discord channel is enabled.

Config.Name: Slack webhook URL
Config.Description: Required if the Slack channel is enabled.

Config.Name: ntfy topic URL
Config.Description: The topic URL, server included — ntfy.sh or an instance of your own.

Config.Name: Gotify server
Config.Description: Required if the Gotify channel is enabled.

Config.Name: Pushover token
Config.Description: Required if the Pushover channel is enabled.

Config.Name: Teams webhook URL
Config.Description: Required if the Microsoft Teams channel is enabled.

Config.Name: Generic webhook URL
Config.Description: Required if the generic webhook channel is enabled.

Config.Name: Generic webhook secret
Config.Description: Optional. Set it and every request carries an HMAC signature.
